premises.text: Safe drinking water requires near-complete bacteria reduction, but germs are invisible and a billion people lack dependably safe water
premises.evidence_span: One billion people on the planet cannot get dependably safe drinking water because of them

premises.text: Existing options force a trade-off between products that do not remove germs and methods that need electricity, pumping, time, or bad taste
premises.evidence_span: the world has had to make a fundamental trade-off. On one hand, you had products that didn't work, and on the other hand, you had products that were really hard to use

premises.text: Ultra-thin fiber membranes in a cartridge deliver instantly safe water with no chemicals, electricity, or pumping
premises.evidence_span: you can get instantly safe drinking water with no chemicals, no electricity, and no pumping

premises.text: Product path starts with a personal bottle then expands to household and industrial/commercial uses as an enabling water-tech platform
premises.evidence_span: Our plan is to become an Intel inside that powers an entire generation of new products in the water industry

premises.text: Rollout stages from US/Europe wellness and recreation markets to emerging-market middle classes, then lower-cost bottom-of-pyramid reach
premises.evidence_span: we've already started in the United States and Europe, where we're reaching out to the health and the wellness and the recreational markets

domains.name: safe water access and ineffective alternatives

value.text: Make safe drinking water ordinary, commonplace, and universal anytime anywhere
value.evidence_span: make water into something that's ordinary and commonplace and universal
